Net signal: the skill reliably makes the model apply the layered pattern without exploring the repo first, which is fast and correct in the textbook sense — but the eval-0 assertions can't currently tell 'skill-template-conformant' apart from 'codebase-precedent-conformant', and this run shows those two can genuinely disagree.
